coastal.title: Rubber meets the road for Lime e-bike share launch in Victoria
coastal.description: Green arches have sprung up alongside streets in Victoria in recent weeks, as the city prepared to roll out a new e-bike share program. Starting Friday, the new bikes will hit the road – a fleet of green and white electric machines ready for riders.

kamloops.title: More Summerland residents allowed home as Bald Range fire grows to 24,000 hectares
kamloops.description: The Regional District of Okanagan-Similkameen has downgraded an evacuation order to an alert for nearly the entire community except the Garnet Valley area.

kamloops.title: OPP renew call for help after remains of B.C. woman found in Ontario
kamloops.description: Ontario Provincial Police are renewing calls for help in solving a 21-year-old case involving the remains of a British Columbia woman found in the province.

prince-george.title: 'This is our place': Indigenous mural at centre of new Prince George housing project
prince-george.description: A new mural at a Prince George housing project reflects Carrier Sekani culture and the local landscape. Created with Indigenous youth, the work is meant to make the new multi-age building feel welcoming, culturally grounded and like home.
